findings: Existing467-condition cohort and all family/test partitions reused verbatim. Original four features, fitted records and evaluation result objects preserved.
Recovered confidence data and Rosetta values verified against source-file SHA256s; pLDDT binder mask and symmetric full cross-chain PAE recomputed independently.

K/M and all contact-residue IDs recomputed using standalone PDB parsing and4Å nearest-atom distances. Saved scoring PDBs contain no hydrogens, correctly documented as input difference from relaxed BindCraft.
New scalers use training rows only. All64 newly fitted logistic models replay correctly; no threshold or hyperparameter selection.
Paper-strict and code-inclusive analogue filters are separate, predetermined diagnostics. Missing three criteria are excluded and conjunction explicitly labeled incomplete.
These are ESMFold2-Fast/unrelaxed analogues, not AF2 or complete BindCraft pipeline reproduction.
Pooled ROC/PR plots should use pooled metrics; headline primary remains weighted within-fold metrics.
Prior observed heldout results informed the follow-up panel choice; this is exploratory, not an untouched confirmatory test.
